Ability.name: Abyssal Ward
Ability.effect: Wraps the caster in protective shadows from the deep, increasing defense by {power}% and reflecting {power/2}% of incoming damage for {turnLength} turns.

Ability.name: Sanity Drain
Ability.effect: Exposes the enemy to incomprehensible visions, dealing {power}% of attack as psychic damage each turn for {turnLength} turns.

Ability.name: Cosmic Devastation
Ability.effect: Unleashes the raw fury of distant stars, dealing {power}% of attack as cosmic damage that ignores {power/2}% of enemy defense.

Ability.name: Eldritch Regeneration
Ability.effect: Channels cosmic energies to restore {power}% of max health each turn for {turnLength} turns, drawing power from the void itself.

Ability.name: Void Whispers
Ability.effect: The abomination whispers forbidden truths that weaken the enemy's resolve, reducing their attack and defense by {power}% for {turnLength} turns.

Ability.name: Dream-Eater’s Embrace
Ability.effect: Siphons living flesh to your own, deals {speed} * {power}. 3 turns.

Ability.name: Crawling Chaos
Ability.effect: Chaotic matter infects the target, deals {speed} * {power}. 5 turns.

Ability.name: Eldritch Tentacle
Ability.effect: Lashes out with a shattering tentacle, deals {attack} * {power}.

Orb.name: Eldritch Whispers
Orb.description: Apply a curse for {benefit} to the enemy at the end of a turn.

Talent.name: Void Champion

Talent.name: Reality Bender
Talent.description: Warp the fundamental laws. Your abominations can use abilities 20% more often.

Talent.name: Echo Mastery
Talent.description: Master the currency of madness. Gain 25% more Echoes from all sources.

Talent.name: Flesh Mastery
Talent.description: Command over biological matter grants your abominations +5% to all base stats.

Talent.name: Dream Walker
Talent.description: Navigate the realm of sleeping minds. Fusion costs are reduced by 20%.

Talent.name: Cosmic Speed
Talent.description: Bend spacetime to your will. All abominations gain +15% speed.

Talent.name: Void Sight
Talent.description: Channel the raw power of the deep. All abominations gain +15% attack power.

Talent.name: Frenzied Claws
Talent.description: All of your abominations gain a 5% bonus to their base Speed.

Talent.name: Abyssal Strength
Talent.description: All of your abominations gain a 5% bonus to their base Attack.

Talent.name: Stellar Defense
Talent.description: Armor forged from starlight protects your abominations. +15% defense to all.

Talent.name: Eldritch Vitality II
Talent.description: Infuse your creations with otherworldly life force. All abominations gain +20% HP.

Talent.name: Carapaced Hide
Talent.description: All of your abominations gain a 5% bonus to their base Defense.

Talent.name: Eldritch Vitality
Talent.description: All of your abominations gain a 5% bonus to their base HP.

Campaign.name: Eclipsed Halls of Eternal Night
Campaign.story: In the shadowed recesses of the Eclipsed Halls, whispers of the ancients entwine with the fabric of darkness, hinting at the unfathomable horrors that linger just beyond the veil of sanity. Here, the air thrums with an unholy resonance, as the Gibbering Dream-Shambler beckons from the abyss, its laughter a cacophony of despair that rends the very essence of reality. To confront this abomination is to awaken lost truths better left buried; for in its presence, the line between dream and nightmare...

Campaign.name: Nameless Spire of Shattered Dreams
Campaign.description: A twisted place where reality frays.
Campaign.story: As the weary travelers ascend the spiraling path of the Nameless Spire, the air grows thick with the whisper of forgotten sorrows, each echo promising truths better left undisturbed. Shadows writhe upon the cold stone walls, as though the very remnants of shattered hopes seep from cracks unseen, beckoning the unwise to unearth their lingering despair. Within the crumbling tower, an insidious presence lurks, poised to awaken the specters of ancestral nightmares, waiting to reclaim what was forsak...

Campaign.name: Whispering Labyrinth of Eternal Night
Campaign.description: A twisted place where reality frays.
Campaign.story: In the suffocating gloom of the Whispering Labyrinth, echoes of the ancients curl around you like the tendrils of a long-forgotten nightmare, each whisper unraveling the threads of sanity. Shadows twist and writhe ahead, hinting at a truth best left buried beneath the weight of aeons, where the very walls seem to breathe with the agonizing secrets of a cosmic horror. As you tread deeper into this abyss, remember: in the absence of light, the unblinking eyes of the dark will not just observe, but...

Campaign.name: Eclipsed Caverns of Forgotten Gods
Campaign.description: A twisted place where reality frays.
Campaign.story: In the shadowed depths of the Eclipsed Caverns, where the light of forgotten stars no longer penetrates, whispers of long-slumbering deities curl like smoke through the damp air. Unearthed by the foolish and the desperate, the echoes of ancient rituals thrum beneath your feet, beckoning you closer with promises laced in madness. Beware, for the secrets you seek may awaken beings for whom time and sanity are as fleeting as shadows in the dark.

Campaign.name: Nameless Citadel of a Thousand Eyes
Campaign.description: A twisted place where reality frays.
Campaign.story: As you step into the shrouded halls of the Nameless Citadel, an unsettling multitude of unseen gazes pierces through the shadows, as if the very stones themselves are witnesses to a forgotten horror. Whispers of lost knowledge echo from the depths, a cacophony of voices that entwine with the air—a siren's call to those brave enough to unearth their lingering despair. Beware, for the eyes that observe from the eternal dark are not merely of flesh and bone; they are remnants of an unspeakable truth that should have remained entombed.

Horror.name: Faceless Watcher
